description: Thirst-aware automatic drinking for Traveler's Backpack. Minecraft 1.21.1 / NeoForge. By Izcool.

mods.name: Thirst Was Upgraded
mods.description:
Adds thirst-aware automatic drinking functionality
to Traveler's Backpack.

item: Automatically drinks water and other drinks from the backpack to quench thirst

releases.notes:
First stable release for **Minecraft 1.21.1 / NeoForge 21.1.248+**, by **Izcool**.

- Automatic drinking from Traveler's Backpack storage and both water tanks.
- Nine allow/block filter slots, thirst thresholds, and water-purity controls.
- Resource-pack-aware button backgrounds and native Thirst Was Reclaimed water symbols, compatible with Create New World Core's existing hook.
- Backpack tank-filling fixes and optional Create / Tough As Nails integration.
- 143 language files; 28 rare locales use the English fallback documented in TRANSLATIONS.md.

Requires **Traveler's Backpack 10.1.38+** and **Thirst Was Reclaimed 1.21.1-3.0.4+**.

Install `thirst_was_upgraded-neoforge-1.21.1-1.0.0.jar` on both client and server, replacing older versions of this addon. Existing upgrade IDs and saved settings are preserved. SHA-256 checksums are attached.

Validation: all 17 regression tests and translation validation pass. Code and assets match 0.0.7; only the packaged version changes.
